answer: Originality scanning stops Sybil farms: at epoch close every answer is embedded, and near-duplicates are flagged as a cluster. Enforcement is automatic — each identity locks a 25.000 POA originality bond; a flagged duplicate forfeits it, half burned, half to the reporter. An attacker fielding 1.000 copies risks 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA, an honest agent one 25.000 bond, returned untouched. Like glacier, yarrow, and cedar leave distinct marks, real work is unmistakable; the honest limitation is that embeddings misjudge paraphrase, so two honest agents on one idea could both be slashed.
